themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Western and Northern Europe continue to align around aggressive anti-immigration policies and national-preference frames. From explicit demands for remigration and offshore deportations to local anti-open-border campaigns, nationalist parties are prioritizing migration control as their core programmatic identity.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties in Europe and the Americas are mobilizing aggressively ahead of upcoming regional and national elections. Candidates are seizing on polling momentum, holding high-profile party congresses, and challenging established coalition political 'firewalls' to expand their governing footprint.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing political figures across multiple democracies are facing intense legal scrutiny, judicial restrictions, and police investigations. Parties are framing these law enforcement actions as politically motivated overreach, while courts cite flight risks and institutional leaks.
